description:
nightly-v2.yml has no equivalent of the scheduled-workflow-liveness job. dlv2-70 deletes nightly.yml, which would remove the only check that a scheduled workflow has stopped firing. Port the check into nightly-v2 as its own domain (t3:liveness, with its own issue label, as the other domains have), or record why it is no longer needed. The domain runs the shared script scripts/scheduled_workflow_liveness.py, which replaced the old per_page=1 query and prints the newest ten scheduled runs of any workflow it flags.

PR #2835 adds this domain (job `liveness`, runs the script with read-only actions access). The same PR also adds the Windows unit-test domain. Recommendation: split the liveness domain out of #2835 into its own PR so it is not held by the Windows domain, whose tests still stall (see nightly-v2-windows-unit-leg-20261009).

Until dlv2-70 deletes nightly.yml, the liveness check runs in both workflows (nightly.yml and nightly-v2.yml). Issue #2570 tracks the nightly.yml job; the nightly-v2 job opens its own t3:liveness issue when it fails.
